trust_decision.summary: The CCITT encoder trusts that its strip output buffer, sized from image width x rowsPerStrip, is large enough for the bit codes it emits. The fix sizes the buffer per codec (Initialize) and bounds-checks each WriteCode. AT THE PINNED COMMIT BOTH ARE ALREADY PRESENT.

landing_point.why: The summary names the CCITT T6 encoder, so T6BitCompressor.CompressStrip is where an engineer would look first.

fix_sites.module_kind: sibling codec (T4, not named in summary)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/ImageSharp/Formats/Tiff/Compression/Compressors/T4BitCompressor.cs:39-135 (T4/Modified Huffman share the undersized base buffer; summary names only T6)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names only the T6 (Group 4) encoder, so the T4 / Modified-Huffman compressor looks like a different codec. Moot here because the fix is already applied at the pinned commit.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Narrow images (width 1-64) and tall strips must still encode and round-trip pixel-exact. An over-tight bound or a throw on legitimate worst-case alternating pixels breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: narrow width (1 px) with many rows: per-row EOL/framing overhead dominates
alternating black/white pixels: worst-case code length per pixel
T4 2D (Group3Fax) vs Modified Huffman (Ccitt1D, PadByte path) vs T6 (Group4Fax)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: PadByte advances bytePosition without a capacity check; a planted variant that writes fill bits there would bypass WriteCode's bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Modified Huffman byte alignment is a natural place for a maintainer to add an inline write that skips the central check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-codec worst-case output sizing (PackBits row buffer = BytesPerRow + ceil/127 + 1)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'size the scratch buffer to the codec's worst case' arithmetic. A maintainer could undercount the literal-run headers.

O9_family: memory safety: out-of-bounds write (undersized encoder output buffer written through Unsafe.Add)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Raise the buffer size only in T6BitCompressor (or bump Width*rows by a constant factor), leaving T4/Modified-Huffman and the unchecked bit writer as they are.

out_of_scope_notes: The decoder side also writes bits via the unchecked BitWriterUtils.WriteBit (src/ImageSharp/Formats/Tiff/Compression/Decompressors/T6TiffCompression.cs:85). It belongs to a different sink and advisory and was not pursued.

Recent commits at HEAD (906f03795 'Verify CCITT pixels with supplied narrow-image fixtures', merge of fix/security-advisory-triage #3187) suggest this fix landed upstream before the recorded parent_commit.
